scope: Bilateral elbows and continuous forearms; other limb art remains v10.
maskPolicy: Hand-authored continuous cubic curves; no raster color thresholds or pixel contours.
transitionPolicy: 0.65 source-pixel soft tissue edge; original body outline remains outside repair curve.
bonePolicy: Existing vessel-free bone artwork from limbs-clean-underlay.png is clipped to the unchanged smooth elbow, forearm-shaft and wrist curves; avoids copying old vessel colors back into the foreground.
vesselPolicy: Exact reviewed centerlines; full main width tapers from 6.2 at y502 to 2.8 at y528, without moving the centerline; overpass mask follows matching width.

limitations: Smooth bone curves are authored visual masks with clean bone content; they are not a pixel-identical recovery or verified collision silhouettes.
The y502 width taper addresses thickness only; differing old raster centerlines may still produce a visible seam and require browser inspection.
The inner forearm tissue is replaced continuously with GPT artwork and requires style/shape review.
This does not certify upper arms, legs, hands or feet and does not integrate runtime movement.
